Following up on the infra/tech evidence items. A few notes on scoping and what we can provide safely:

- Regions: Redwood runs customer workloads in us-west-2 and us-east-1 for hosted; we can confirm EU regions for Private/Dedicated customers but the hosted catalog listing will note US region by default. If Greenleaf needs EU-only, we should flag that as a restrictable offering in the listing.
- Logs: we will provide a sanitized sample export (no customer PII) and a short playbook describing the log retention policy (default 90 days, can be adjusted under enterprise contract).
- Pen test: the attestation includes a summary of findings; full raw reports contain sensitive data so we will provide the letter and remediation summary only.
- Scope matrix: attached is a scoping CSV that maps marketplace requirement -> Redwood artifact / notes. Use this to populate the marketplace form.
